none: PAS NLM-19D503: Roman Coin: Nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly a copy of Gratian (367-383) Gloria Novi Saeculi issue of 367-375, Reece period 19, Arles mint. Obverse description: Diademed bust draped and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Emperor standing facing with shield [and standard]. O in left field. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. Diameter: 13.4mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: 12
